scope_notice: This matrix compares only public, citable product claims with repository-verifiable Xiaoyi evidence. It is not a head-to-head model evaluation and does not infer undisclosed model quality, production KPIs, customer outcomes, or security controls.

sources.publisher: COSCO SHIPPING Technology / MyVessel product site
sources.title: Shipping Intelligence and Hi-Dolphin product overview
sources.claims_used: 100k+ registered users, 120k+ daily requests, 100+ agents, 27 B2B enterprises, 400m+ maritime tokens, 500k+ fine-tuning QA pairs, 1,888 evaluation questions, data query, API/MCP and visualization capabilities

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Maritime knowledge Q&A with structured knowledge and a 1,888-question public evaluation set
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Hybrid RAG, 129 documents, 882 chunks, 260 repository-authored fixed cases and citation/claim/numeric gates
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Run a common independent MaritimeBench protocol and publish per-domain accuracy, failure rows and hashes

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Natural-language access to global vessel, port, route and weather data
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Eight fail-closed connector contracts; zero verified live external systems in the open-source package
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Authorize and validate AIS/port/weather adapters with freshness, field mapping, drift and outage tests

dimensions.reference_public_capability: 100+ maritime agents with intelligent data query, online search, APIs and MCP services
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Audited dry-run task planner, read-only capability registry, four-system handoff and explicit human confirmation
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Publish task-success and unsafe-action-block rates on a shared tool-use benchmark; add authorized connectors without widening write authority

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Ship-port analysis, capacity trends, berth waiting and route-related data products
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Public AIS calibrated replay plus reproducible RL/PID/SOP comparison; all current RL candidates rejected
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Obtain authorized port-call labels and compare ETA/wait predictions against seasonal and operational baselines on chronological blind tests

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Publicly reported user, request, enterprise and agent deployment scale
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Single-node local open-source acceptance package; no verified production-user or concurrency evidence
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Complete a consented pilot, concurrency/load tests, availability SLO and user outcome study

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Public product descriptions do not expose comparable repository-level run artifacts and failure ledgers
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Open code, fixed datasets, hashes, multi-seed reports, failed candidates, immutable historical evidence and fail-closed release checks
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Keep independent third-party reproduction and signed release provenance; do not convert transparency into a blanket superiority claim

dimensions.reference_public_capability: Public materials describe controllable compute and enterprise deployment, but do not expose a directly comparable open authority-admission contract
dimensions.xiaoyi_evidence: Local-only model option, JWT/RBAC, explicit data-egress gate, prompt-injection isolation, recommendation-only and production_authority=false
dimensions.next_acceptance_gate: Independent threat model, red-team report, SBOM, CodeQL and site rollback drill

superiority_claim_gate.reason: No common independent benchmark, no equivalent live proprietary data, and no comparable production-scale study are available.
superiority_claim_gate.safe_claim: Xiaoyi currently demonstrates stronger open reproducibility and explicit fail-closed evidence boundaries in this repository; it has not been proven to surpass Hi-Dolphin overall.
